name: Comprehensive Power Ranking
author: KentJ
description: Adds a standalone comprehensive national power ranking for WorldBox, scoring each civilization by military, economy, population, cities, renown and territory.
description_cn: 为 WorldBox 新增一个综合国力排行榜，综合评估每个文明国家的军事实力、经济、人口、城市数量、名望和领土规模。

compatibility.note: Built against the public WorldBox game API; no game files are modified.
